facts.fact: On 12 May 2026 the national health solidarity fund (CNASS) launched its digital services on the national portal Khidmaty, offering online affiliation, secure online contribution payment and file tracking, with EU support.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Administrative Modernisation

Document gives no account-ownership survey figure.
Document names no mobile money or retail payment service.
Health insurance contributions to the fund are not taxes, duties or state fees as defined.
